title: Critical Review Frozen Subject
description: One immutable statement of what is under review, written once before any standing is resolved. Scope, packet, optional record, and optional resolver-owned panel manifest are bound by content digest. A repository subject additionally binds the full commit and exact regular-file list; a packet-only subject identifies no repository epoch and is admissible only for an all-inline roster carrying complete evidence bytes. There is deliberately no working-tree kind.

schemaVersion.description: Pins this subject contract; a consumer that accepts an unknown version is guessing at what was frozen.

kind.description: Closed in both directions. `repository` review reads named files at one commit; `packet-only` review reads nothing but the verified bytes carried to it. `working-tree` is absent on purpose rather than unsupported by accident.

scopePath.description: Absolute path the assurance scope was read from. Provenance for a later audit, never the reviewer's source of truth: the scope bytes travel in the reviewer assignment itself.

scopeSha256.description: Digest of the exact assurance-scope bytes. The scope fixes the class, assets, adversary, caps, and result-validity conditions a reviewer is bound by, so an edit after freezing changes what the review was for.

packetPath.description: Absolute path the immutable packet was read from, for the same provenance-only reason.

packetSha256.description: Digest of the exact packet bytes, including the two authorization grants that decide which reviewers may receive the material at all.

recordPath.description: Absolute path of the frozen review record, when the subject binds one. Required for any class whose roster the protocol owns.

recordSha256.description: Digest of the exact record bytes. The record is dispatch control state rather than reviewed material, so it is bound by digest and not reproduced to reviewers.

manifestPath.description: Absolute path of the resolver-owned panel manifest whose selected evidence-delivery modes were validated before freeze.

manifestSha256.description: Digest of the exact panel manifest bytes, making a changed roster a changed subject.

manifestSchemaPath.description: Fixed skill-relative schema used to validate the bound manifest.

manifestSchemaSha256.description: Digest of the exact manifest schema bytes used at freeze.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the repository root. The root and not a subdirectory, because a file list resolved from a subdirectory names other files.

subjectCommit.description: The full lowercase commit the subject was frozen at, which must equal HEAD over a clean tree at freeze and at every later verification. Abbreviated revisions are refused: they identify a prefix, not an object.

items.description: One exact repository-relative POSIX path, bound in `subjectCommit` as a regular blob. Directories, symlinks, and submodule gitlinks are refused: none of them fixes the bytes a reviewer would read.

files.description: Every reviewed path, sorted and unique. An empty list is not a narrow subject but an unbounded one, so it is invalid.

subjectDigest.description: Digest over this subject's whole identity -- kind, every bound component digest, optional manifest and its schema, commit, and file list -- so two subjects differing in any one of them are different subjects. Every receipt, envelope, and reviewer assignment carries it as the join key.

then.description: A repository subject is exactly a commit plus a file list. Missing either leaves a subject that can only mean the current working tree.

else.description: A packet-only subject has no repository, so carrying a commit or a file list would claim a repository epoch nothing verified.

then.description: A record is bound by path and digest together. A path without a digest binds nothing, and a digest without a path names nothing.
A panel manifest, its schema, and the record that selected it are bound as one unit; no path-only or digest-only manifest claim is valid.
